art_direction: 高颈瓶、矮碗与一枝弯叶组成有机平面静物，陶红和冷蓝互相穿插。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Build a graphic still life of a tall narrow-necked bottle, a shallow bowl, and a single curved leaf stem. Treat all objects as original flat organic shapes, with overlapping color areas that reveal their relationships. Use terracotta, pale blue, dark ink, and a small lime accent against cream. Place the bottle slightly off center and let the bowl extend across its base. Add only a few internal cutout curves to suggest openings. Keep the silhouette unified and avoid imitation of any named artist or recognizable artwork. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
